content.short: Chainsim lets users mint NFT phone-style numbers for private logins and blockchain-verified authentication.
content.description: Chainsim is an identity and authentication app for TON users. The project page describes NFT numbers that can be minted with a TON wallet and then used for private logins, one-time codes, and app verification without exposing a real phone number or email. It is best understood as a privacy-oriented login layer rather than a wallet or exchange. Chainsim is developer or operator infrastructure, so its value is backend support rather than a consumer wallet or token page. Chainsim is kept in this TON set because its product has a concrete user or builder workflow, not only a loose mention of the network.
